profile.positioning: I’m Alejandro Jansen, Founder and CTO of SynapseFlow. We’re building the next generation of predictive maintenance solutions leveraging cutting-edge computer vision and machine learning to dramatically reduce downtime and optimize performance for heavy industrial equipment. My background blends a deep technical foundation in robotics and AI with five years of practical experience working directly on manufacturing lines. This unique perspective allows us to develop solutions that aren’t just theoretically sound, but genuinely solve real-world problems for our customers. We’ve recently completed a successful closed-beta program demonstrating a 20% reduction in unscheduled downtime for a key partner, and we’re now focused on scaling our platform and expanding our pilot program. I’m passionate about the transformative potential of AI in manufacturing, and actively seeking partnerships with forward-thinking organizations ready to embrace the future of industrial efficiency.

profile.lookingFor:
I’m actively seeking Series A funding to scale SynapseFlow’s operations and expand our team. We’re looking for investors with a strong understanding of the industrial AI landscape and a long-term investment horizon.  I'm particularly interested in connecting with venture capital firms specializing in industrial technology.  

Beyond funding, we are aggressively pursuing pilot program opportunities with large industrial companies – specifically in the automotive, aerospace, and energy sectors. Ideal partners would have a significant installed base of complex machinery and a clear commitment to digital transformation. We are flexible on pilot scope, but prefer engagements that allow for a full-scale deployment following a successful proof-of-concept.

I’m also open to introductions to key decision-makers within these organizations – heads of maintenance, digital transformation leaders, and CTOs. I’m less interested in purely marketing or sales-focused connections, and prioritize conversations with technical leaders who understand the value of a data-driven approach to predictive maintenance.
profile.notes: Alejandro is a highly intelligent and driven individual with a genuine passion for solving real-world problems with AI. He’s technically brilliant, but can sometimes get lost in the details and struggle with delegation. He’s very direct and values efficiency – avoid overly formal or lengthy introductions. He’s acutely aware of the hype surrounding AI and is skeptical of solutions that lack demonstrable results. Any introduction should emphasize the tangible benefits SynapseFlow delivers – quantifiable improvements in uptime, efficiency, and cost savings. He recently expressed frustration with a potential partner who lacked a clear understanding of their existing data infrastructure.  Focus on companies with robust data collection capabilities. He is responsive but prefers concise communication.
profile.locationAvailability: I’m primarily focused on opportunities within North America, but am open to exploring partnerships globally with the right strategic fit. I am based in Boston, MA, and frequently travel to manufacturing sites throughout the US.
